description: I’m Asif, a robotics and autonomy software engineer (MES, Lamar University) focused on path planning and ROS2. We’re building an interactive Mars map with terrain-aware route planning for the Martian Map challenge. Goal: a polished, working demo. All skill levels welcome. Looking for: web/3D developers, data visualization, geospatial data, design/video, and a space science or writing person. Message me on the team page before Nov 14.
